rationale: Both recommend validator-first and are useful, but B better helps a careful decision-maker. It gives a clearer staged plan, sharper reasoning about why sequencing matters, and more discriminative treatment of alternatives, especially journalist-first and adversarial-first. It also adds California-specific targeting and explains how to use validators with reporters and social launch. A is concise and solid, but its caveat handling is thinner and its comparison table is less developed. Neither provides strong quantitative evidence beyond rough counts/timelines, so both score low there.
